settings.heading: For those who never got to say it

settings.text: Not all words are said out loud. Some are worn

settings.heading:
What you carry inside.

What you cannot express with words.

Now it has a place.
Shaped by land and sea

settings.heading: The morning I got in the car and drove west to the Atlantic
settings.text:
I don't know exactly when I decided. Or whether I decided at all. I just got in the car one morning and drove. West, toward the Atlantic. Without thinking. As if my body knew what it needed before I did.

Family had been around for three weeks. Everyone wanted to help. But nobody understood that I needed to be alone for a moment.

My mother was gone.

I had spent three weeks doing everything right. Calling who I needed to call. Saying what I was supposed to say. Smiling when it was time to smile. I was good at that.

What I wasn't so good at was staying still.

This is not a gentle coast. Anyone who has stood on the Atlantic side of this country knows that. It is raw, cold, and it doesn't care about you. The waves break against the dark rocks whether you are there or not. It doesn't stop for you.

That is why I went there.

I needed something that wouldn't stop for me.

I walked along the shore for hours. It was the first time in weeks I was completely alone. A strong wind was blowing off the Atlantic. The shingle was dark and wet under my boots. The cliffs rose around me on both sides.

At some point I crouched down and picked up a stone. I don't know why. It was smooth, grey, and fit perfectly in my hand. I didn't let go of it.

I picked up more. And more.

When I got back to the car my pockets were full.

That same evening I sat at the same kitchen table where she used to sit. I just looked at the stones in front of me. And then I started making something from them.

For her. Even though she was no longer here.

I never got to tell her while she was alive. That I really saw her. That I knew everything she had done for us. That she always put herself last. That I felt a gratitude I never knew how to say out loud.

The piece I made that evening was my way of telling her.

Too late. But I told her.

Since then I have designed hundreds of pieces. For mothers, daughters and women carrying something they don't know how to express. And for women who simply need to feel that they are enough.

Every time I find a stone on the Atlantic shore I think of her.

And every time I place a finished piece on the old wooden table it is still for her.

Even though she is no longer here.

— Aoife

settings.question: Can I give it as a gift?
settings.answer: Yes. Many people give it as a gift — to a mother, a daughter, or a friend who carries something they don't know how to say. Write to me if you want help choosing.

settings.question: When will I receive my jewelry?
settings.answer:
Your order will be shipped via Registered Post and should arrive within 4–7 working days, depending on sizing, special instructions, and order requirements.

If I am unable to dispatch your order within our standard delivery timeframe, I will contact you to discuss the delay and advise you on the best available options.

I offer free shipping within the Republic of Ireland.

settings.question: What does it mean that no two pieces of jewelry are alike?
settings.answer: The stones in my jewelry each have their own unique character — no two are alike. The piece you receive will look like the image — but will never be identical. That is part of what you are ordering. The piece you receive is owned by no one else.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: I offer free shipping within the Republic of Ireland.

settings.question: What size should I choose?
settings.answer: Use the size guide on the product page. If you have any doubts — write to me. I will gladly help you.

settings.question: Can I return the jewellery?
settings.answer:
You have 14 days to return your jewellery. Simply contact me by email, and we will help you arrange the return.

Guarantee: All pieces come with a 2-year quality guarantee covering manufacturing defects.

settings.question: How to pay
settings.answer:
You can pay with Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Shop Pay, Google Pay, and Apple Pay.
All payments are secure and encrypted by Stripe. You will not be charged until your order is confirmed.

settings.question: How can I write to you?
settings.answer:
You can write to me directly here
I reply myself. No assistant. No automatic messages.

I sit at the kitchen table in the evenings and read my messages. You will hear from me in less than 48 hours.

If you have questions about a design, a size — or simply want to tell me your story — write to me. I read everything.

— Aoife
